versions.label: Version 1 · Local
versions.notes: Lists, cards, drag & drop, checklists, labels, members. Data stored locally in the browser (no sync).

versions.label: Version 2 · Shared
versions.notes: Adds a shared realtime backend (Firebase Firestore): live multi-device sync via a secret board link. Original Trello-style card layout (calling as title).

versions.label: Version 3 · Card redesign
versions.notes: Cards now lead with the proposed person's name as the headline and the calling as the subtitle; 'Unassigned' placeholder when no person is set.

versions.label: Version 4 · Quick advance
versions.notes: Adds a per-card → button that moves a card to the bottom of the next stage, with an inertial glide animation.

versions.label: Version 5 · Touch drag
versions.notes: Rebuilt drag & drop on pointer events (mouse + touch): long-press to pick up on mobile, drop anywhere over a list, edge auto-scroll to cross columns. The → advance button is now always visible.

versions.label: Version 6 · Mobile drag fix
versions.notes: Drag now actually works on touch: touch drags are driven by touch events (not pointer events, which the browser cancels on scroll), the picked-up card stays in the DOM so events keep flowing, and scrolling is suppressed only while dragging. Long-press to drag, quick-swipe to scroll.

versions.label: Version 7 · Double-tap advance
versions.notes: Removed the → button. Double-tap (or double-click) a card to advance it to the next stage; single tap opens it. Cards no longer double-tap-zoom on mobile.

versions.label: Version 8 · Snappier tap
versions.notes: Reduced the single-tap-to-open delay / double-tap window from 260ms to 160ms, so cards open faster (double-tap to advance must be a bit quicker).

versions.label: Version 9 · Plain version badge
versions.notes: Removed the version dropdown/switcher. The top bar now just shows the current version number as static text.

versions.label: Version 10 · Cache-busting
versions.notes: Added versioned ?v= query strings to the root's app.js/styles.css (auto-bumped each release) so browsers pick up new deploys instead of serving stale cached files.

versions.label: Version 11 · Assignees
versions.notes: Roster is now the 4 bishopric members (Eljon Serrano, John Sombrero, Ace Magno, Arvin Navarra). Existing card assignees are cleared once; each card shows a placeholder profile icon — click it (or the modal's Assignee section) to assign one person from the roster.

versions.label: Version 12 · Mobile-optimized
versions.notes: Bigger touch targets on phones (assignee icon, header pills, list menu, pickers, checklist boxes all ≈40–44px), near-full-width columns, larger card text, 16px inputs (no iOS zoom), and a de-cluttered header on small screens.

versions.label: Version 13 · Bottom sheet
versions.notes: On phones the card view is now a bottom sheet covering only the lower part of the screen (board dimmed above). Dismiss by pulling it down, tapping the dimmed area, or Close. Desktop keeps the centered dialog.

versions.label: Version 14 · Simplified cards
versions.notes: Removed checklists, the watching icon, and the days-in-stage counter/badges from cards and the card modal. The assignee icon moved to the top of the card, aligned with the name.

versions.label: Version 15 · Interview dates
versions.notes: Cards in 'For Interview' get a calendar chip next to the assignee, defaulting to the upcoming Sunday (or today if Sunday). Tap it to pick another date. The list auto-arranges by date, earliest first.

versions.label: Version 16 · Calendar icon
versions.notes: The interview date now renders as a mini macOS-Calendar-style icon (red month header + big day number). Clicking/tapping it reliably opens the native date picker (via showPicker).

versions.label: Version 17 · Smaller calendar
versions.notes: The calendar icon is now the same height as the assignee icon (28px desktop / 42px touch) instead of oversized.

versions.label: Version 18 · Interview time
versions.notes: Added an interview time (default 9:00 AM) shown next to the calendar icon; tap it for a native time picker. Fixed the date/time pickers not opening on mobile (the transparent input is now the tap target, so the OS picker opens directly). For Interview now sorts by date then time.

versions.label: Version 19 · Combined date-time badge
versions.notes: Date and time are now one event-style badge (red month header over day + time) opened by a single datetime-local picker for both. Cleaner design; default time is 11:00 AM.

versions.label: Version 20 · 24-hour time
versions.notes: Interview time shows in 24-hour format (e.g. 11:00, 15:30) to save space on the badge.

versions.label: Version 21 · Compact date-time badge
versions.notes: The interview badge is now two columns: left = calendar (red month over day), right = hour over minute. Narrower than the single-row layout.

versions.label: Version 22 · Auto 20-min scheduling
versions.notes: Interviews are auto-scheduled in 20-minute slots from 11:00 with no double-booking per interviewer: cards are grouped by assignee + date and given the next free slot (a manually-picked time is kept and reserves its slot). Existing cards are rescheduled accordingly; the picker steps in 20-minute increments.

versions.label: Version 23 · 5-min picker
versions.notes: The manual date/time picker now steps in 5-minute increments (auto-scheduling still uses 20-minute slots).

versions.label: Version 24 · Mobile 5-min time wheel
versions.notes: iOS ignores the step attribute on time inputs (always 1-minute), so the time is now a native <select> that renders as a wheel of real 5-minute options — works on mobile. The badge's two columns are separate native tap targets: calendar → date picker, clock → 5-minute time wheel (42px targets on touch).

versions.label: Version 25 · Pastel members + Stake
versions.notes: Each member now has a fixed, distinct pastel avatar color (Eljon blue, John peach, Ace purple, Arvin green, Stake pink) with dark text — no more Eljon/John clash. Added 'Stake' to the roster.

versions.label: Version 26 · Combined picker + reorder animation
versions.notes: Reverted to a single combined date+time picker (one tap opens one picker on mobile and desktop); the picked time is snapped to the nearest 5 minutes. When 'For Interview' re-sorts (e.g. after a time change), the cards animate (FLIP) sliding to their new positions.

versions.label: Version 27 · Custom 5-min picker
versions.notes: Reverted the interview badge to the v23 two-column calendar design. Replaced the native inputs with a custom combined date+time picker (calendar month grid + a scrollable list of real 5-minute times, 07:00–21:00) — one tap opens it, it renders as a bottom sheet on phones, and it works correctly on mobile (no more 1-minute snapping). The change is only committed when you tap Done, and the For-Interview reorder animation now plays only after the picker closes and runs more slowly (0.5s).

versions.label: Version 28 · iOS wheel picker
versions.notes: Rebuilt the interview date/time picker to look and feel like the native iOS wheel picker: three spinning drums (date · hour : minute) with a translucent center selection band and rows that curve and fade at the edges. It's a frosted 'liquid glass' modal — the panel and backdrop are translucent and blurred, so the board stays visible behind it. Cancel/Escape/tap-away dismiss without changes; Done commits (still only on Done, so the reorder animation runs once).

versions.label: Version 29 · iOS graphical picker
versions.notes: Rebuilt the interview picker to match the native iOS graphical date picker: a calendar month grid for the date (‹ › month nav, selected day as a blue circle) and a 'Time' pill that reveals the iOS-style time wheel (hour · minute · AM/PM, real 5-minute steps, translucent center band). It's a dark frosted 'liquid glass' modal, so the board stays visible behind it, with a Reset pill (revert to automatic scheduling) and a blue ✓ to confirm. Nothing commits until ✓ is tapped.

versions.label: Version 30 · No double-booking
versions.notes: Fixed interview scheduling so it never double-books a person: previously two cards with the same manually-picked time on the same day for the same interviewer both kept that time (a conflict). Now a colliding pick is automatically bumped to the next free 20-minute slot, and cards without a pick fill the remaining slots — every interviewer's cards get a unique time.

versions.label: Version 31 · Solid picker surface
versions.notes: Made the interview picker panel a solid dark surface so the calendar grid and time wheel read cleanly (the board no longer bleeds through the picker's content). The board is still dimmed and faintly visible around the panel, so it stays a modal you can see behind.

versions.label: Version 32 · Frosted-glass modal picker
versions.notes: Reworked the interview picker to match the reference exactly: it's now a centered floating modal (not a full-width bottom sheet); the panel itself is frosted 'liquid glass' that blurs only what's directly behind it while the rest of the board stays sharp (no backdrop blur); and tapping the time makes the time wheel pop up as a floating panel IN FRONT of the calendar instead of expanding below it.
